The numbers of vehicles shown in Table 2 by source type are either equal to or fewer than those given in that report. There are fewer vehicles reported for speed distribution because not all the data were collected at a level of resolution to calculate the road type. In addition, we excluded a fleet of six regional-haul vehicles in the combination short-haul source type (VID 144-149) included in the FleetDNA database because the recorded vehicle speeds appeared to be capped at a low vehicle speed (EPA 2021).1 We use the same vehicle IDs in this analysis as that report so users can identify common vehicles between the two data sets.
